notes: Splunk exposes Splunk Web on 8000 and a management API on 8089. A free-license and/or unauthenticated instance is high impact: app upload leads to code execution as the splunk user. Treat an exposed/free/unauth Splunk as a finding in its own right, not a log line.

checks.title: Splunk free-license / unauthenticated instance exposed
checks.when: 8089 banner says 'free license; remote login disabled', or Splunk Web on 8000 is reachable without auth / with default creds
checks.validation: Read the 8089 banner and the 8000 login page; a free license or anonymous/default-cred web access enables app-upload RCE.

checks.title: Splunk management API on 8089
checks.when: 8089 is open (often missed by top-ports scans)
checks.validation: nmap -sCV -p8089; check /services/server/info for version and licenseState.

checks.title: Splunk default credentials (admin:changeme)
checks.validation: Try admin:changeme ONCE on the web login, with operator approval and within scope. No brute-force.
